title: The Thousand Years, The Defeat of Satan, The Great White Throne Judgment

questions.question: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding in his hand the key to the ____ and a great chain.
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:1 (ESV): "Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding in his hand the key to the bottomless pit and a great chain."

questions.question: And he seized the dragon, that ancient serpent, who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a ____ years,
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:2 (ESV): "And he seized the dragon, that ancient serpent, who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years,"

questions.question: and threw him into the pit, and shut it and sealed it over him, so that he might not ____ the nations any longer, until the thousand years were ended.
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:3 (ESV): "and threw him into the pit, and shut it and sealed it over him, so that he might not deceive the nations any longer, until the thousand years were ended. After that he must be released for a little while."

questions.question: Then I saw thrones, and seated on them were those to whom the authority to ____ was committed.
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:4 (ESV): "Then I saw thrones, and seated on them were those to whom the authority to judge was committed..."

questions.question: Also I saw the ____ of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God...
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:4 (ESV): "...Also I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands..."

questions.question: They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years. The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended. This is the ____ resurrection.
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:4-5 (ESV): "They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years. The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended. This is the first resurrection."

questions.question: Blessed and holy is the one who shares in the first resurrection! Over such the second ____ has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ...
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:6 (ESV): "Blessed and holy is the one who shares in the first resurrection! Over such the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and they will reign with him for a thousand years."

questions.question: And when the thousand years are ended, Satan will be released from his prison and will come out to deceive the nations that are at the four corners of the earth, ____ and ____,
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:7-8 (ESV): "And when the thousand years are ended, Satan will be released from his prison and will come out to deceive the nations that are at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them for battle; their number is like the sand of the sea."

questions.question: And they marched up over the broad plain of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city, but ____ came down from heaven and consumed them,
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:9 (ESV): "And they marched up over the broad plain of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city, but fire came down from heaven and consumed them,"

questions.question: and the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur where the ____ and the ____ were, and they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:10 (ESV): "and the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur where the beast and the false prophet were, and they will be tormented day and night forever and ever."

questions.question: Then I saw a great white ____ and him who was seated on it. From his presence earth and sky fled away, and no place was found for them.
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:11 (ESV): "Then I saw a great white throne and him who was seated on it. From his presence earth and sky fled away, and no place was found for them."

questions.question: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and ____ were opened.
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:12 (ESV): "And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Then another book was opened, which is the book of life."

questions.question: And the dead were judged by what was written in the books, according to what they had ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:12 (ESV): "...And the dead were judged by what was written in the books, according to what they had done."

questions.question: Then ____ and ____ were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:14 (ESV): "Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire."

questions.question: And if anyone's name was not found written in the book of ____, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:15 (ESV): "And if anyone's name was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire."

key_verse_text: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Then another book was opened, which is the book of life. And the dead were judged by what was written in the books, according to what they had done.
